Summarise multiply imputed LE8 scores with dplyr

Source: R/methods-summary.R
summarise.essential8_imputed_scores.Rd

The summarise() method for scores from score_le8_imputed(). Without expressions, it returns the pooled statistics in summary(), one row per measure and group. With expressions, it is ordinary dplyr on the stacked data sets; add .imp to .by to summarise each imputation separately.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'essential8_imputed_scores'
summarise(.data, ..., .by = NULL, .groups = NULL)

Arguments

.data

An essential8_imputed_scores object.

...

Summary expressions. If any are supplied, the call is handled by dplyr::summarise().

.by

<tidy-select> Optional columns to group by for this summary.

.groups

Passed to dplyr::summarise() when ... is supplied. Otherwise ignored; the LE8 summary is always ungrouped.

Value

Without expressions, an ungrouped data frame with the grouping columns, measure, and the pooled statistics: n, n_missing, mean, std.error, conf.low, conf.high (95%), df, fmi, and the averaged sd, min, q25, median, q75, and max. With expressions, the result of dplyr::summarise().

See also

summary.essential8_imputed_scores()
